__1 To defend, preserve. 
__2 To strike, injure.
a. Thick; मुखं मुकुन्दस्य गुडालकावृतम् [[Bhāg. 10. 38. 9.]] cf. गुडाकेशः.

__1 Treacle, molasses; गुडधानाः [[Sk.]]; गुडौदनः [[Y. 1. 304]]; गुडद्वितीयां हरीतकीं भक्षयेत् [[Suśr.]] 
__2 A globe, ball; साग्निः सगुडशृङ्गिका [[Mb. 3. 15. 8.]] 
__3 A ball for playing with. 
__4 A mouthful, bit. 
__5 An elephant's armour. 
__6 The cotton tree. 
__7 A pill; [[Śāraṅg. S. 13. 1.]] 
-Comp. 
-उदकम् water mixed with molasses. 
-उद्भवा sugar. 
-ओदनम् rice boiled with coarse sugar; [[Y. 1. 303.]] 
-करी f. N. of a Rāgiṇī (गुर्जरी). 
-तृणम्, -दारुः, -रु n. sugar-cane. 
-त्वच्-चा f. the aromatic bark of the Laurus Cassia (Mar. दालचिनी). 
-धेनुः f. a milch-cow symbolically represented by molasses and offered as a present to Brāhmaṇas. 
-पिष्टम् a sort of sweetmeat, flour and molasses ground and boiled together; [[Y. 1. 289.]] 
-फलः the Pīlu tree. 
-शर्करा refined sugar. 
-शृङ्गम् a cupola. 
-शृङ्गिका an apparatus or missile for throwing balls; [[Mb. 3. 15. 8.]] 
-हरीतकी myrobalan preserved in molasses (Mar. मुरांवळा).

[गुडेन पक्वः वा° कन्] 
__1 A ball; सभुशुण्ड्यश्मगुडका [[Mb. 3. 15. 8.]] 
__2 A mouthful. 
__3 A kind of drug prepared with molasses. 
-डिका 
__1 A small ball. 
__2 A pill. 
__3 Kernel. 
-कम् Molasses.

(Thick-haired) 
__1 An epithet of Arjuna; मम देहे गुडाकेश यच्चान्यद् द्रष्टुमर्हसि [[Bg. 11. 7.]] (and in several other places of the Gītā.) 
__2 An epithet of Śiva.
A rattling in the throat (as breath) caused by cough.

गुडु(डू)ची
N. of a very useful medicinal plant, Cocculus Cordifolius (Mar. गुळवेल).

__1 A ball, glove.
